events.title: Women's Bikepacking Overnight w/ Earth Mountain!
events.description: Women’s Overnight Bikepacking Trip with Earth Mountain! Join us for a women’s overnight bikepacking adventure through Pisgah National Forest with Earth Mountain! This bikepacking trip is a great opportunity to learn the basics, spend a night in the woods, and connect with other women who love riding and exploring. The total route is approximately 39 miles with 3,770 feet of climbing , with about 1,500 feet of climbing each day. The route includes options for gravel and single track, so both gravel and mountain bikes are welcome! Route : Looking Glass Loop Overnight What to Expect: Bring the good vibes: We're always stoked to be in biking and camping in the woods, and even moreso to share it with a rad group of ladies.
